notes: Chromium mobile emulation on this runner. Cold/cached readiness includes synchronization; save timing is browser click to saved-row DOM feedback. Physical iPhone validation remains required.

measurement.percentile: Nearest-rank p95; with five startup runs this is the largest sample. Save p95 spans 100 samples.
